header.description: Char panel derivations (FAM-05): frmMain RefreshCPs, RefreshHitPoints, RefreshMagic, RefreshPicklocks, RefreshMagicRes, RefreshDodge, RefreshMainStatBonuses, SetupClass, lblInvenCharStat_Change, CharStatAdjustmentPrompt and the mana-per-round total of RefreshCharBless
notes: Each case calls one procedure cut out of frmMain.frm (scenario key frm) and reads back the captions, tags and globals it writes; the step's call name says which. Controls MME reads are in the case's forms.

lblInvenCharStat_Change is cut at its 'tooltip:' label (what follows is tool-tip placement) and only the encumbrance-level indexes 0 and 1 are run; indexes 2, 3, 8 and 24 call RefreshMagicRes and RefreshDodge, which have their own cases.
CharStatAdjustmentPrompt: the InputBox call is replaced (scenario subs) by a read of frmMain.tsInput.Caption; an empty answer is MME's Cancel. PopUpChooseCombatGUI and RefreshAll are stubs.
SetupClass: ResetFilterOptions is a stub; ListCount of the two spell-magery combos is an input, and an unset ListIndex reads -1.
RefreshCharBless: only lblCharBless.Caption (the mana-per-round total) is new here; bless_Stats is the gear family.
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra); data holds every row the cases use, for the Rust test.
